column1: # Three catalogues on one key, one row per HIP number; bright stars with Gaia G between 8 and 10.5,
# Gaia ruwe < 1.1 and parallax_over_error > 5, 80 stars with all three entries.
# Gaia DR3: ESA archive, gaiadr3.gaia_source joined to gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour, epoch J2016.0.
# Hipparcos: ESA 1997, HEASARC TAP table hipparcos, epoch J1991.25.
# Tycho-2: HEASARC TAP table tycho2, epoch J2000.0.
# units: positions deg, proper motion mas/yr, parallax mas, errors as each catalogue publishes them.
